obligation.exact_statement: C3 and mathematical C4 under current D1-D8: re-establish the exact finite adapter/bit/compiler/program premises required for the fixed MIX63+output41 and JOINT18+output41 programs; prove all closed-box guards and actual erasure, and every explicit D6 Bstar coordinate including one-shot batch resident banks, masks/metadata, words/addresses, dense zeros/holds, online work/storage/peak, guarded3(b+1) output and offline generation. For N3–5 no frontend/cut or fictitious observations; actual input and uniform guarded writes fit Bstar(6,b,d). With newly admitted C1/C2, prove on d>=32,N=2^(2d+74),Q=2^(2d),u=2^(-d-16) one SAME Phi_* and MIX-selected SAME t_* give JOINT R_av<u/64,R_00<1/64 versus MIX>=3u/64,>=3/64, hence gaps>u/32,>1/32. Carry total conditional displayed upper Theta(eta), not O(eta^2). Prove and explicitly price the alternative gain j=C, locked-count packing when8ceil(log2(M+1))<=19min(d,h), including d>=195, and precomputed-output packing when b<=19min(d,h), including b=2d. Preserve exact three-primary claim mapping and scope: common upper envelope is not equal expenditure, optimized architecture efficiency or arbitrary-encoder lower. This component does not itself establish later independent review or administrative completion.

assumptions: D1-D8 fix the stationary source, full actual finite encoders, integer error cut, precise protected/public information and cost model.
Source-independent predictor family is not supplied unknown u,t. Same-source and same-map witness quantifiers are as C1-C3, not universal per-source dominance.
All input acquisition, binding, features, masks, finite arithmetic, copies, clears, holds, code, generation and output are charged; no clean-data bypass.
The common budget is the principal extracted-query one-shot hybrid model, not padded all-phase, streaming, flattened or unit-cost RAM.
Source files and prior discussion PASS are provenance only. No new proof depends on old Dot absolute noise laws or claims optimized architecture advantage.

quantifiers.domain: one executable D4 family depending only on observed history and public N,b,d
the full C1 domain with unknown u,t and all D3 maps
one deterministic globally admissible public map independent of t and the decoder, for the C2 tuple
all common source-independent randomized decoders of the fixed FULL19 cut
one of1/4,3/4 witnessing both conditional and u-weighted average lower for that decoder
integers>=32 with the exact C3 tuple and the same witness/map
